layout.borders: Fine continuous frame and section dividers

decisions: Use the supplied wordmark and S-block brand mark; preserve navy and blue as the main brand colors.
Use the real supplied dashboard screenshots. Native 3360px PNGs are used inline and in the full-screen viewer.
Use approved temporary Fraunces and Manrope until licensed Recoleta and Axiforma webfonts are supplied.
Body copy is 16px on desktop and 14px on mobile; headings are at least 18px; compact labels are 14px / 12px.

October 18 direction supersedes the earlier pastel-card and frameless-image treatments: audience photography sits beside white editorial copy with fine dividers, without colored card bodies or floating icon tiles.
Benefits are alternating product stories with focused screenshot views and concise captions; screenshots occupy most of each story width.

Product images use restrained window chrome, contextual labels, native-resolution CSS crops, a full-screen affordance, visible focus, subtle pointer hover and reduced-motion support. Crops clarify the feature; the full original is always available.

Election setup is a numbered sequence. Communication features form a divided list beside the actual composer. Voting modes form a two-column comparison. Avoid repeated rainbow icon tiles and rounded pastel shells.
The election monitor shows overview, voter reminder, turnout and all participation bars; do not crop away charts.
Keep the existing copy, module-tab behavior, pricing, inquiry flows, legal drafts and cookie settings working.
Core Platform and Elections retain separate pricing entry points. Contact admin@strukthq.com.
Local preview only. No publication or push is authorized for this design pass.

Add an own-product workflow hub before the homepage module tabs. Eight actual service areas connect to the supplied full-color S-block (the transparent favicon asset), never the faded hero watermark. Thin directional connectors and restrained movement respect reduced motion.
Screenshot frames use a slim neutral macOS-style title bar, red/yellow/green decorative window controls, a fine gray border and small full-screen icon. Shared styling applies to both pages.

Replace the visible organization name list with the seven supplied full-color customer organization logos; keep them unboxed and evenly spaced in one desktop row, then center them into readable rows on narrow screens.
Use the supplied 1920×1038 COMPSSA live election monitor in the Elections hero and participation image, with full-frame fit and the original PNG available in the image viewer.
21st: Search attempted on October 18; CLI is installed but not authenticated. Implemented using the existing static HTML/CSS and researched references, without adding dependencies.
